name: Malcolm, Keen-Eyed Navigator
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever one or more Pirates you control deal damage to your opponents, you create a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
Partner (You can have two commanders if both have partner.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more Pirates you control deal damage to your opponents, you create a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")

needs.what: a 'whenever one or more <filter> you control deal damage to your opponents' trigger over ANY damage (combat and noncombat), batched across every matching source in one simultaneous damage event (a combat damage step, or one effect op), firing once per batch and exposing the set of damaged opponents -- here as a count ("for each opponent dealt damage") usable as `create_token`'s `amount`, e.g. `batched: true` accepted on `deals_damage_to_player` (added to `BATCHED_EVENTS`, grouped by the `batch` that `damage_player` stamps) with a value reading the number of distinct damaged opponents in the batch
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `creatures_deal_combat_damage` with `per_player` and `defending: "opponent"` gives one Treasure per damaged opponent but is combat damage only, so a Pirate's noncombat damage would be missed -- a narrower card. `deals_damage_to_player` hears noncombat damage but is keyed per source: two Pirates hitting the same opponent would fire twice and make two Treasures, and `batched` is refused there because it is not in `BATCHED_EVENTS`. The effect (`create_token` of `treasure_token`) and Flying/Partner are expressible; only the trigger and its damaged-opponent count are missing
